note: Shoshone NF campground in the conifers at the north end of the Chief Joseph Scenic Highway (WY-296), about 46 miles from WY-120; Lake Creek cascades past just west of the sites. Spurs are short: the FS posts a 22-ft maximum, so a 23-ft rig is right at the limit. Bear boxes. No cell service. --Claude
